name: Camp Koda
street_address: Georgia Elementary School, 4416 Ethan Allen Hwy.
description_short: The Greater Burlington YMCA's state licensed day camp at Georgia Elementary School, for kids who have finished kindergarten up to age 12. Each week has a theme, and campers spend most of the day outside with water play, games, STEM and art.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel two weeks or more before a week starts for a tuition refund, less the deposit; cancel later and nothing is refunded. The $30 registration fee and $25 weekly deposits are non-refundable.
notes: 2026 rate shown; 2027 details are coming, with registration opening at the Y's Camp Expo on January 24, 2027 and online January 25. Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5:30pm. 3 days a week is $255, 5 days $360, plus a one time $30 registration fee and a $25 deposit per week. Families on Vermont child care subsidy skip the fee and deposits, and Y scholarships are available after applying for the subsidy. Campers bring lunch and two snacks. The same camp also runs at Barre Town School, 70 Websterville Rd, Barre.

for_andrew: Camp Koda runs at two schools, Georgia Elementary and Barre Town School, with the same ages and prices; only Georgia has a week 1. I made one listing at Georgia and named Barre in the notes. Want a second listing for Barre?

The Koda page also lists the Y's own building in Burlington as a location, but the overview table puts Burlington under the separate Camp at the Y in BTV ($375 and $430), which is already published. I treated the Burlington site as that camp.
